title: MCP Tools Appearing Duplicated in Claude Code Interface
body:
## Bug Report

All MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools are appearing duplicated in the Claude Code tool selection interface.

## Environment
- Platform: Linux (WSL2)
- Claude Code: Latest version
- MCP Server: zen-mcp-server (affects all MCP servers)

## Issue
Every MCP tool shows up multiple times in the tool selection interface, creating confusion when selecting tools.

## Expected Behavior
Each MCP tool should appear only once.

## Actual Behavior
All MCP tools are displayed multiple times.

## Reproduction
1. Install any MCP server
2. Open Claude Code
3. View MCP tool selection
4. Notice duplicate tool entries

## Visual Evidence
Screenshot attached showing the duplication issue.

This affects all MCP server integrations in Claude Code.
